In 'Zij grijpt het je jaren later met beide handen aan', the construction members are only 'grijpt', 'handen', and 'aan': 'je jaren later' is never a member. A contiguous construction has exactly one span and its members form exactly one adjacent run. A discontinuous construction has at least two ordered, non-overlapping spans and its members form at least two separate runs. Do not invent token IDs, block indices, or source spans.
